decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight builds directly on the firm's core knowledge of modular lighting systems and design-led luminaires, so its planning tools, light advisers and dealer feedback let it read early results and refine the line rather than abandon it a year after launch.

The LED ceiling luminaire sits squarely within the firm's established product knowledge and dealer channels, giving it the capacity to assimilate market feedback and improve the line, and a drop is unlikely in a growing industry so soon after launch.
